originality.rationale: FAIL. A previously published Nov 8 maximal-dissociation theorem for the SAME rook graph explicitly proves the identical three-component classification AND the identical UNRESTRICTED factorial count for each component triple (a,b,c). It then adds a maximality predicate to its displayed summation. Deleting precisely that predicate yields the entire candidate all-set polynomial term-by-term, with the same constraints under variable renaming. This is a direct mathematical corollary of the earlier published proof, despite a different maximal-versus-all theorem title. The max formula is elementary optimization of the same existing feasible component constraints, and earlier 2011 work and PUMaC also cover special maxima. It cannot be accepted solely because the unrestricted polynomial was not separately boxed.
